name: io.github.gambot-ai/gambot-mcp
title: Gambot WhatsApp Business API
description: Send WhatsApp messages & templates and manage CRM, leads & campaigns via the Gambot WhatsApp API.

environmentVariables.name: GAMBOT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Your Gambot Token (gmbt_…) from Gambot Settings → General. OPTIONAL: leave it unset if you don't have an account yet — the server then starts in token-less ONBOARDING mode (self-serve account creation only). Set it to unlock the full tool set (messaging, campaigns, CRM, bots, analytics).

environmentVariables.name: GAMBOT_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Optional override for the API base URL (defaults to https://api.gambot.co.il/api/v1).
